The three additions at **`C:\Users\stop-\learning-japanese-ru\words\門.md:9`** are justified:

| Direct pair | Decision and evidence |
|---|---|
| 門–家 | **Retain.** Daijisen かど sense3 explicitly includes 家. The actual caption «дом; жилище» contains the applicable alternative «дом». |
| 門–家族 | **Retain.** Sense3 also gives 一族・一門, corroborating the captured family sense and actual «семья» caption. |
| 門–庭 | **Retain.** Sense2 explicitly denotes the area before the gate/garden around it. This directly overlaps «сад; двор», not merely an associated location. |

The complete short modern Daijisen subsection supplies no archaic qualifier for those senses. Its proverb example supports the family/household use without establishing unrestricted substitution.
